identity_policy: Pin manifest URI, SHA256 and exact VersionId. Discovery pointer is mutable and is never a scientific pin.
retention_policy: Create-only objects, manifest last after full exact-version byte checks; no deletion or completed-object expiry.
sharing_policy: Owner-authorized private preservation does not approve redistribution; honor source restrictions and retain notices. Credentials are forbidden.
source_policy: Git commit/path for source, reviews, candidate designs, configs and concise findings. Pinned acquisition/reconstruction recipes for disposable copies.
local_storage_policy: Git for source and concise findings; S3 for all useful persistent data/evidence/results/unfinished state. Local ignored directories are scratch/cache only. Publish and pin before handoff; evict only after fresh exact-version byte verification.
